author_or_org: Akhil Padmanabha, Jessie Yuan, Janavi Gupta, Zulekha Karachiwalla, Carmel Majidi, Henny Admoni, Zackory Erickson

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The paper presents a framework for incorporating LLMs as speech interfaces for physically assistive robots, developed iteratively through three testing stages with a feeding robot and a final study with 11 older adults.
claims.quote: In this work, we present a framework for incorporating LLMs as speech interfaces for physically assistive robots, constructed iteratively with 3 stages of testing involving a feeding robot, culminating in an evaluation with 11 older adults at an independent living facility.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The paper provides design guidelines for using LLMs as speech interfaces for assistive robots, validated with quantitative and qualitative data from the final study.
claims.quote: We use both quantitative and qualitative data from the final study to validate our framework and additionally provide design guidelines for using LLMs as speech interfaces for assistive robots.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Speech interfaces, especially those using LLMs, can enable individuals to communicate high-level commands and nuanced preferences to robots.
claims.quote: Speech interfaces, especially ones that utilize Large Language Models (LLMs), can enable individuals to effectively and naturally communicate high-level commands and nuanced preferences to robots.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Prior frameworks for integrating LLMs as interfaces to robots for high-level task planning and code generation fail to incorporate human-centric considerations essential for assistive interfaces.
claims.quote: Frameworks for integrating LLMs as interfaces to robots for high level task planning and code generation have been proposed, but fail to incorporate human-centric considerations which are essential while developing assistive interfaces.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Physically assistive robots offer an opportunity to significantly increase the well-being and independence of individuals with motor impairments or other forms of disability who cannot complete activities of daily living.
claims.quote: Physically assistive robots present an opportunity to significantly increase the well-being and independence of individuals with motor impairments or other forms of disability who are unable to complete activities of daily living.
